methodology: Identical real inputs run on the same Linux x86_64 host against real installed versions of esbuild, terser, javascript-obfuscator, js-confuser, strip, UPX 4.2.4, OpenSSL, and Vibe-Slayer.

javascript.honestNote: Baseline control; zero build/runtime overhead, 100% readable source
Fastest build & smallest output; minification only (not security)
Standard production minifier; smallest static bundle, zero tamper/offline defense

elf64.honestNote: Baseline unstripped ELF64; symbols & .rodata strings fully exposed
